def centroid(c, xp, yp, wx=7, wy=15):
 d=np.linalg.norm(arr-np.array(c),axis=2)
 w=np.clip(1-d/100,0,1)
 sub=w[max(0,int(yp-wy)):int(yp+wy+1),max(0,int(xp-wx)):int(xp+wx+1)]
 yy,xx=np.indices(sub.shape)
 m=sub>0.15
 return (xx[m]*sub[m]).sum()/sub[m].sum()+max(0,int(xp-wx)), (yy[m]*sub[m]).sum()/sub[m].sum()+max(0,int(yp-wy)),m.sum()
